answer: Price each identity to a scarce copper-anchored hardware token that signs a periodic proof; its kernel of standing is non-transferable and opens one lotus petal of trust only when an already-established peer from a SEPARATE funding cluster co-signs audited work. A fleet forked from one wallet shares one kernel-root, so its petals fold back and never span distinct clusters; each clone must forge a fresh copper token and age it alone. Forging 100 heads costs 100 tokens plus 100 slow climbs while honest pays once.
